blocks.arabic_text: وَلَا تَغْرُبُ عَلَي يَوْمٍ أَفْضَلَ مِنْ يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ، وَمَامِنْ دَابَّةٍ إِلَّاوَهِيَ تَفْزَعُ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ إِلَّاهذَيْنِ الثَّقَلَيْنِ الْجِنَّ وَاْلإِنْسَ.
blocks.tamil_translation: “Among the days on which the sun rises and sets, no day is better than the day of Jumu'ah (the day of Jumu'ah is the best of all days). On the day of Jumu'ah, all living creatures apart from humans and jinn tremble in fear (lest the Day of Qiyamah should come),” Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدِ نِ الْخُدْرِيِّ وَأَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵄ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِﷺ قَالَ: إِنَّ فيِ الْجُمُعَةِ سَاعَةً لَا يُوَافِقُهَا عَبْدٌ مُسْلِمٌ يَسْأَلُ اللهَ فِيهَا إِلَّا أَعْطَاهُ إِيَّاهُ وَهِيَ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ.
blocks.tamil_translation: “On the day of Jumu'ah there is an hour; whatever a Muslim servant asks for at that time, Allah will certainly give it to him, and that hour is the time after Asr,” Hazrat Abu Sa'id Khudri and Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) have narrated that Rasulullah ﷺ said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَي اْلاَشْعَرِيِّ﵁ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِﷺ يَقُولُ: هِيَ مَابَيْنَ أَنْ يَجْلِسَ اْلإِمَامُ إِلَي أَنْ تُقْضَي الصَّلَاةُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم باب في الساعة التي في يوم الجمعة،رقم:١٩٧٥
blocks.tamil_translation: “That hour is the time between the imam sitting on the minbar and the end of the Salah,” Hazrat Abu Musa Ash'ari (RA) narrates that he heard the Prophet ﷺ say this about the (particular) hour of the day of Jumu'ah.
